pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal dark regions on the flank with relatively smooth pixel gradients at the edges. Patch size is maximal on the mid-flank and decreases toward the ventral and posterior regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light pelage with junction nodes connecting three to four adjacent patches. Corridor pixel thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank but becomes wider and less distinct toward the lower neck and ventral areas.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck and shoulder presents a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette characterized by short, dark bristles against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark-plumaged bird is perched on the dorsal ridge at the transition between the upper neck and shoulder.
